rows.grounds: points to the hidden true nature as the object of knowledge
expresses the prior act of realizing that nature
compound denoting a concealed essential reality
names the state that comes into being
asserts the emergence of that state

items.question: What state arises from knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: There is a hidden true nature.
That hidden true nature can be known.
Knowing it leads to a resulting state.
items.inference: Knowing the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: The referent of taṃ may draw on the immediately preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
